name: context-menu
notes: A rounded-bordered popup whose item ENABLEDNESS depends on state: the Selection kind disables Copy when selection_text is empty, the Message kind disables both when there is no message at the index. any_modal_open is TRUE while it is open — the context menu is one of only two extras outside overlay_flags() that any_modal_open ORs in — which is why this scenario asserts the flag is up, not down.
